thread:
inc-bot: Paging oncall: detected a cluster-wide spike in correctable ECC errors and multiple NVidia Xid resets on gpu-pool-7. Threshold exceeded for 5m, auto-evac triggered.

alex: seeing lots of Xid 124 and 31 in dmesg, node-17 and node-21 mostly. Containers OOMing while KVCaching.

morgan: confirmed, metrics show 3x increase in driver resets starting 04:12 UTC. Latency spiking for inference jobs.

sanjay: any customer impact yet?

tara: support-liaison here — a handful of customers reported transient 5xx on /v1/generate since ~04:15. No broad outage but error rate bumped to 2.8%.

oncall: I'm taking this. Immediate plan: cordon node-17/21, drain non-critical pods, and hold scheduling to gpu-pool-7. Rolling reprovision for evicted nodes.

eng-lead: agree. Also kick off telemetry dump from nodes: `sudo journalctl -u nvidia-driver -n 1000 > /tmp/driver-log-node17.txt` and `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,HOST | tee /tmp/ecc-node17.txt` — collect attachments for postmortem.

alex: past runs show this pattern when memory bit flips cause driver grief -> repeated resets -> kworker flooding -> container oom. Could be thermal or DIMM-related.

inc-bot: NOTE: auto-evac policy fired for node-21 at 04:17:23 UTC (evac-id 0x7c2).

morgan: I pushed a quick throttling patch to the routing layer to avoid sending new long seq infer jobs to that pool. That should cut token churn while we stabilize.

sanjay: are we running any experimental driver patches?

oncall: No, nodes are on prod NVIDIA 525.89.02. No midcycle driver changes.

ops-bot: Observed GPU ECC correction counters jump: node-17 GPU0: 34->180 in 3m. Correctable errors only so far.

alex: I'll try a graceful driver reload on node-17 after cordon. If reload fails, plan B is reboot.

tara: customers affected: cust-a (low error burst, retrying), cust-b (persistent 5xx), cust-c (rate-limited failovers triggered). Support is notifying cust-b on our mitigation steps.

eng-lead: sanjay, can you run a kvcache memscan on the hung containers? `pmap` dumps and check for sudden address growth. We suspect a kernel-mmap leak after reset storms.

sanjay: starting now, will post output in a minute.

oncall: handoff note for next oncall — we've cordoned gpu-pool-7, throttled routing, collecting logs, and will attempt driver reload + telemetry-only reboot sequence. Estimated RTO for affected nodes 20-30m.

alex: driver reload attempt on node-17: `sudo modprobe -r nvidia_uvm && sudo modprobe nvidia_uvm` — returned: kernel reports pending Xid during unload, reload aborted. Reboot queued.

morgan: kicked a controlled reboot for node-17 and node-21 with `reboot --no-wall` to avoid losing in-flight telemetry. Reboots started 04:28.

ops-bot: telemetry note: during pre-reboot we captured kernel oops traces pointing at `nv-hostengine` and repeated `GPU exception: Xid 63` followed by `Xid 31` bursts.

support-liaison: Updated cust-b: we are performing rolling reboots of a subset of GPU nodes; they may see short-lived errors for next 30 minutes. Apologized and offered post-incident summary.

eng-lead: if reboots do not clear ECC correction storms, escalate hardware team for DIMM/PCIe link checks. Also consider shifting heavy batch jobs to cpu-only pools.

inc-bot: ACTIONS: cordon gpu-pool-7, throttle routing, collect logs, reboot node-17/21, notify customers, schedule hardware follow-up if persists.

oncall: I'm compiling an oncall handoff note for the 04:45 rotation: include logs at /artifacts/incidents/5080001111/, timeline of Xid spikes, and support ticket IDs for cust-b.

morgan: metrics update at 04:45 — error-rate dropped to baseline after reboots, ECC counters still elevated but stable. Holding fleet in watch for another hour.

oncall: thanks team. I'll remain primary until handoff. If anyone sees a renewed Xid burst ping @oncall.

eng-lead: postmortem blurb: root cause unknown yet — initial hypothesis: intermittent ECC correction avalanche on specific GPUs triggering firmware/driver interaction that cascades to resets and OOMs. Will open follow-up with hardware ops and vendor support.

support-liaison: logging closure for cust-b; will send status update after postmortem available.

inc-bot: Incident closed for active paging at 05:12 UTC; monitoring continues.
